text: Clients on the subnet containing the DHCP server work; clients on every other subnet get APIPA addresses. What is missing?
choices: A DHCP relay agent (ip helper-address) on the other subnets' routers
explanation: Routers do not forward broadcasts, so a server on one subnet cannot hear clients on another. Someone troubleshooting the failing subnet finds nothing wrong with it, because nothing is wrong with it.
